issue.title: task-tag-marks 'session toggle and onload wiring' fails: bank-marks subscription dispatches an extra editor refresh on load
issue.description:
## What fails

Repo: bob-plugins (linked). On master 3dc30c7,
`node --test scripts/test-ledger-tools-task-tag-marks.cjs` fails
`session toggle and onload wiring` (line ~922): `assert.equal(dispatched.length, 1)`
gets 2. It fails every run, in isolation and in the full suite.

## Root cause (confirmed)

Bisected over d94c6bb..master: d94c6bb, 9c79123, and 564f3c1 pass; 4e4a580
("feat(ledger-tools): decorate bank month rows in Live Preview and Reading view",
bob-cli-kd.6.1.4) is the first failing commit. A stack probe shows the extra dispatch
comes from `refreshBankMarks` (241p-plugin-bank-marks.js), which a synchronous
`apiBankSubscribe` callback calls during `plugin.onload()` (bankMarkEnsureMonthSubscription /
bankMarkWireEvents). The test's fake leaf counts every `cm.dispatch`, so the bank-marks
refresh lands before the explicit `refreshTaskTagMarkEditors()` call.

## Fix options

Either (a) make the test count only task-tag refresh effects, or (b) make the bank-marks
subscription skip an editor dispatch while no bank month report or bank row is visible
(a wasted dispatch on every load). Keep the bank marks behavior from 4e4a580.

## Reporters

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes on bob-cli-k3.7.1.2 (#4), .3 (#2), .4 (#2), and .5 (#1); triaged
by the bob-cli-k3.7.1 land agent.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails on every run, alone and in the full suite; bisected to first failing commit 4e4a580 and a stack probe identifies the extra dispatch from refreshBankMarks during onload.

issue.creation_reason: Four bob-cli-k3.7.1 phase agents saw this deterministic bob-plugins unit failure on their clean base; the land agent bisected it to bank commit 4e4a580 (bob-cli-kd.6.1.4, now closed), so no active epic owns it.
